usageNotes: Use this to retrieve all PVE remote connections registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. The response contains only remote IDs — follow up with a per-remote detail call to get connection parameters (host, port, credentials). No parameters are required; the endpoint returns all remotes the authenticated token has visibility into.
tips: Remote IDs follow the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]* (2–32 chars); use the returned IDs as the 'remote' path param in subsequent per-remote endpoints.
An empty array response means no PVE remotes are registered yet — add one via the PDM UI or the create-remote endpoint before querying cluster or node resources.
API tokens (allowtoken: true) can be used directly; no interactive session cookie is required.
